features.name: verify-gate: Stop runs the repo's verify commands and logs each run centrally
features.description: T8 of docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-17-two-layer-harness-design.md (D8: central, per repo). New template common/verify-gate.sh (Stop): when the turn changed a path matching RELEVANT_RE (its repo config block; changes measured against the upstream merge-base plus untracked files, like the other Stop guards), it runs each verify command from agent-harness.json at the repo root, blocks with exit 2 and the failing command's last lines, and appends one JSON line per run to <runtime>/telemetry/<repo>/verify-runs-YYYYMM.jsonl when the harness is installed. Hook entries take an optional timeout (seconds), passed to every agent's wiring, so a long verify is not cut off by a default hook timeout. hangar replaces its local full-validate.sh (validate.sh, 41s) with verify-gate running ./init.sh (validate.sh + hook tests, 97s) on the same paths plus .claude/hooks; atelier adds it (./init.sh, 10s) on any change.
acceptance_criteria: verify-gate exits 0 with a SKIP line when the turn changed nothing matching RELEVANT_RE; otherwise runs every verify command in order and exits 2 naming the first failing one with its last 40 lines, or 0 when all pass
each run that executes commands appends one line (time, repo, commit, result, duration, each command with rc and duration) to the central log; nothing is written when harness-version.json is missing
hook entries accept an optional positive integer timeout; check rejects anything else; sync writes it into the claude, codex and agy wiring

hangar: full-validate.sh gone, verify-gate wired with timeout 300 and RELEVANT_RE covering what full-validate covered plus .claude/hooks; atelier: verify-gate wired with timeout 120; both ./init.sh pass; a real Stop run is logged
all 11 harness gates pass, with gate output saved to a file
features.verification: bash scripts/tests/test_verify_gate.sh && python3 -m pytest tests/test_harness_adapter.py -q && bash scripts/harness-verify.sh
features.evidence: templates/hooks/common/verify-gate.sh (Stop): when the turn changed a path matching RELEVANT_RE (merge-base plus untracked), runs agent-harness.json verify commands in order, blocks with exit 2 naming the first failing one and its last 40 lines, and with the harness installed appends one line per run to ~/.agent-skills-setup/telemetry/<repo>/verify-runs-YYYYMM.jsonl (ts, repo, commit, result, duration, per-command rc and duration). Adapter hook entries take an optional positive integer timeout, written into claude, codex and agy wiring. Tests failed first: test_verify_gate.sh 6 of 8, tests/test_harness_adapter.py 1 (timeout); now 8 and 29 passed. Mutations caught: ignoring a failing command, dropping the turn scope. hangar 9f46b84: full-validate.sh removed; verify-gate wired with timeout 300 and RELEVANT_RE = full-validate's paths plus .claude/hooks; test-hooks.sh cases 1-3 now test verify-gate with a fixture verify (29 passed). atelier 1844622: verify-gate with timeout 120, any change. Real Stop runs logged: atelier pass 10s; hangar pass 91s (an earlier hangar run failed, logged, because my first fixture made the shared clean test repo dirty for secret-scan; fixed by hiding the fixture through .git/info/exclude). My first version of hangar's tests ran verify-gate with the real HOME and wrote three test rows into the real telemetry dir; those cases now use a scratch HOME and the three dirs (all 'echo FAILED' fixture rows) were deleted. Cost: hangar Stop now runs ./init.sh (validate.sh + hook tests, ~91-97s) instead of validate.sh (~41s) when relevant paths change. Both ./init.sh exit 0; drift none. harness-verify.sh: all 11 gates passed, output saved to a file. Not done: the other Stop guards are not logged (only verify runs are); agy and codex Stop with a 300 s timeout were not run live.

features.name: Skill packs: pack list, per-repo skill_packs, and the measured effect of scoping
features.description: T10 of docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-17-two-layer-harness-design.md, first half. config/skill-packs.json names a core pack (stays global: superpowers process skills, utils, spec-workflow as the router the global rules name, experiment-iteration) and opt-in packs (spec-gated, sre, ai, frontend, infra, tracking, harness-dev); any global skill no pack names stays global. agent-harness.json takes an optional skill_packs list, checked against that file. repo_audit.py reports, next to today's skill tokens, what the repo would load with only core plus its packs. The second half, removing pack skills from the global install and linking them into .claude/skills, .agents/skills and .kiro/skills of each registered repo, changes what every unregistered repo on the machine sees, so it waits for owner decisions (D7, and what unregistered repos keep).
acceptance_criteria: config/skill-packs.json names each pack once per skill and no skill in two packs; a test checks every named skill exists in the global install or registry
check accepts skill_packs naming known packs only and rejects an unknown or core pack
repo_audit reports skill_tokens_scoped (core + the repo's packs + unassigned globals + repo skills) beside skill_tokens, and the skill list with each skill's pack
hangar (infra) and atelier (ai, frontend, spec-gated) declare packs; their audits are saved
all 11 harness gates pass, with gate output saved to a file
features.verification: python3 -m pytest tests/test_harness_adapter.py tests/test_repo_audit.py -q && bash scripts/harness-verify.sh
features.evidence: config/skill-packs.json: core (16 skills that stay global, incl. spec-workflow as the router the global rules name, utils, experiment-iteration) and opt-in packs spec-gated (10), sre, ai, frontend, infra, tracking (kanban-ai, linear), harness-dev. Every name is installed on this machine and every installed skill is in a pack (checked against ~/.claude/skills; a unit test checks only that no skill is in two packs, since superpowers skills are not in this repo). agent-harness.json takes optional skill_packs, rejected when unknown or core. repo_audit.py adds each skill's pack and skill_tokens_scoped. Tests: 41 passed (tests/test_repo_audit.py, tests/test_harness_adapter.py); the new scoped-token and pack-check cases failed first (3; the invalid-pack cases passed early only because skill_packs was then an unknown key). Declared: hangar infra + spec-gated (e0e1468), atelier ai + frontend + spec-gated (0826503) - spec-gated kept in both as the least change while D7 is open. Measured (estimated tokens): skill list hangar 2,380 -> 1,870 scoped, 1,027 without spec-gated; atelier 2,380 -> 1,886, 1,043 without spec-gated. harness-verify.sh: all 11 gates passed, output saved to a file. Not done (second half, waits for owner decisions D7 and what unregistered repos keep): removing pack skills from the global installs and linking them into each registered repo's .claude/skills, .agents/skills and .kiro/skills. Until then nothing an agent loads has changed.
